lines = subprocess.run(["sudo", "crontab", "-l"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()

        new_lines.append("6 * * * * /opt/weather-pipeline/run_timed.sh front_very_far /var/log/vps-front-very-far.log /usr/bin/python3 /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/icon_front_very_far_snapshot.py")

        new_lines.append(l)
